comment: P25 phase 1 control channel: Trunking Signalling Data Units of one to three TSBKs, C4FM at 4800 symbols a second (4FSK, h 0.25: the levels +-1, +-3 at +-600, +-1800 Hz). The discriminator's levels are timed, each data unit found by its 24-symbol frame sync among them (matched in phase: the sense of a discriminator is known; the levels scaled by the sync's +-3) and read to the next one (at most 360 symbols, three TSBKs), a status symbol after every 35 dropped, the dibits read, the sync stripped. The 64-bit NID (BCH (63,16) and its DUID bit) gives the NAC and DUID; the whole 196-bit blocks after it, as many as the frame holds (null bits after the last are left), are each deinterleaved, trellis decoded and checked by their CRC-16, as OP25 reads them. Out come the NID and the TSBKs as messages. The capture is the channel at `sps` samples a symbol, its carrier taken off

timing.comment: block estimation over 256-symbol windows (its square-law line is weak at this roll-off: no gate, the phase alone, tracked)

steps.comment: transmit: status 10 (unknown, inbound or outbound): level -1 of the unit-power four
